items.title: Jimmy Wormworth interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: There are so many people, J.R. Monterose. My father, my uncle.

ctx.x: And you’ve got the Mancusos, and a Montalbano. Lots of great people.
